name: Navstrechu volnam
source:
Morin is a barkeeper with an unusual curse. All people look like shadows to him, except for one mysterious stranger... Solve the mystery of the curse, fight true darkness and mix the most unusual cocktails in the atmospheric visual novel — Into the Waves!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844860/]Steam[/url]]
